description: Dove Endless Summer Watermelon and Guava Nectar Antiperspirant Deodorant
warnings: For external use only. FLAMMABLE. DO NOT USE NEAR HEAT, FLAME, OR WHILE SMOKING. CAN CAUSE SERIOUS INJURY OR DEATH. • Keep away from face and mouth to avoid breathing it. • Avoid spraying in eyes. Contents under pressure. Do not puncture or incinerate. Do not expose to heat or store at temperatures above 120°F/50°C or in enclosed places that can overheat. • Do not use on broken skin. • Stop use if rash or irritation occurs. • Ask a doctor before use if you have kidney disease.• USE ONLY AS DIRECTED. INTENTIONAL MISUSE BY DELIBERATELY CONCENTRATING AND INHALING THE CONTENTS CAN BE HARMFUL OR FATAL.
keep_out_of_reach_of_children: • Keep out of reach of children.
dosage_and_administration: Apply to underarms only. Shake well before each use. Hold can 6 inches from the underarm and spray.
